findings.title: No consent banner or US opt-out mechanism
findings.detail: 6 advertising platform(s) fire (Campaign Manager 360 / Floodlight, Google Ads, Meta Pixel, Microsoft Ads (UET), Pinterest Tag, TikTok Pixel); no CMP, no geo-targeted banner markup and no 'Do Not Sell or Share' / 'Your Privacy Choices' link were found.
findings.recommendation: Enable Shopify's privacy banner (or a CMP) with region rules: opt-in for EU/UK, opt-out link + GPC for US state privacy laws (CCPA/CPRA and others).

findings.title: Not met: Custom pixel overrides page_location — GTM-PWXWHZZ
findings.detail: GA4 hits from the sandbox report the web-pixels sandbox URL as page_location. Why it matters: Wrong page_location breaks every page, landing-page and attribution report.
findings.recommendation: Set page_location/page_title/page_referrer from event.context.document in the pixel.

findings.title: Not met: GA4 — One implementation per property
findings.detail: G-1NHWMSMD59 <- Shopify app: Google & YouTube x21, Shopify custom pixel #21037220 x9, Theme HTML (hard-coded) x5 Why it matters: Two implementations double-count events and revenue.
findings.recommendation: Keep one implementation per property - on Shopify usually the Google & YouTube app, unless GTM carries a richer setup (then switch GA4 off in the app).

findings.title: Not met: GA4 — Page view sent once per load
findings.detail: Duplicates on one page load: G-1NHWMSMD59×3 (from Shopify app: Google & YouTube, Shopify custom pixel #21037220, Theme HTML (hard-coded)) Why it matters: Double page views inflate traffic and deflate conversion rates; for ad pixels they distort optimisation.
findings.recommendation: Remove the second source (app vs GTM vs hard-coded / custom pixel).

findings.title: Not met: GA4 — page_location is the real page URL
findings.detail: Sandbox URL recorded as page_location for G-1NHWMSMD59. Why it matters: Wrong page_location breaks page, landing-page and channel reports.
findings.recommendation: In the custom pixel set page_location/page_title from event.context.document.

findings.title: Not met: Microsoft Ads — Page view sent once per load
findings.detail: Duplicates on one page load: 343240572×2 (from Shopify app: Microsoft Ads, Theme inline script) Why it matters: Double page views inflate traffic and deflate conversion rates; for ad pixels they distort optimisation.
findings.recommendation: Remove the second source (app vs GTM vs hard-coded / custom pixel).

findings.title: Needs attention: GA4 — Single deployment route
findings.detail: Hits come from 2 routes: Shopify app: Google & YouTube x21; Shopify custom pixel #21037220 x9; Theme HTML (hard-coded) x5. Why it matters: Parallel routes double-count, drift apart, and make consent handling inconsistent.
findings.recommendation: On Shopify, keep the native app integration (server-side events, consent API, maintained by the platform) and remove the GTM / theme / custom-pixel copy unless it adds something the app can't.

findings.title: Needs attention: Google Ads — Single deployment route
findings.detail: Hits come from 2 routes: Theme HTML (hard-coded) x17; Shopify custom pixel #21037220 x16; Theme script x1; Shopify app: Google & YouTube x1. Why it matters: Parallel routes double-count, drift apart, and make consent handling inconsistent.
findings.recommendation: Consolidate to one deployment route per platform.

findings.title: Needs attention: Microsoft Ads — Single deployment route
findings.detail: Hits come from 2 routes: Theme inline script x17; Shopify app: Microsoft Ads x6. Why it matters: Parallel routes double-count, drift apart, and make consent handling inconsistent.
findings.recommendation: On Shopify, keep the native app integration (server-side events, consent API, maintained by the platform) and remove the GTM / theme / custom-pixel copy unless it adds something the app can't.

findings.title: GA4 data sent outside GTM
findings.detail: G-1NHWMSMD59 received hits but is not configured in any captured GTM container (likely a Shopify app pixel, hard-coded gtag, or sGTM-only routing).
findings.recommendation: Decide on one owner for each GA4 property to avoid double counting.

findings.title: Needs attention: No unused variables — GTM-PWXWHZZ
findings.detail: 6 variable(s) not referenced by any tag, trigger or variable: DLV - pinterest_quantity, DLV - pinterest_eventData, DLV - pinterest_orderValue, DLV - event, DLV - pinterest_order_id, DLV - pinterest_currency Why it matters: Clutter hides what actually drives data.

findings.title: Needs attention: Google Ads — Dynamic remarketing sends product IDs
findings.detail: No product IDs on Ads hits from the product page or cart. Why it matters: Dynamic remarketing and PMax product audiences need product IDs that match the feed.
findings.recommendation: Send items (id matching the Merchant Center feed) with view_item / add_to_cart.

findings.title: Needs attention: Microsoft Ads — Single UET tag
findings.detail: 2 UET tags receive data: 343239094, 343240572. Why it matters: Extra IDs split audiences and send customer data to accounts nobody watches.
findings.recommendation: Confirm each is owned and in use; retire leftovers from agencies or old accounts.

findings.title: Needs attention: Stack — Third-party request volume
findings.detail: 1391 third-party requests across the visit (19 identified platforms). Why it matters: Tag weight slows pages, which costs conversion rate.
findings.recommendation: Audit apps/pixels that don't earn their weight.

analyst_checklist.item: Check the footer for a 'Your Privacy Choices / Do Not Sell or Share' link (none found on the homepage HTML)
Do GA4 revenue and Google Ads / Meta purchase counts reconcile with Shopify orders (a gap above ~10% usually means a tracking problem)?

GA4, Google Ads, Microsoft Ads are fed by more than one route (GA4: Shopify app, Shopify custom pixel; Google Ads: Shopify custom pixel, Theme; Microsoft Ads: Shopify app, Theme). Who manages each, and which one is meant to be the source of truth?
Are all of these UET tags still in use (any agency or legacy accounts)? 343239094, 343240572.
Is the Facebook & Instagram app's data sharing set to 'Maximum' (Conversions API on), and what Event Match Quality do Purchase events get?
Which conversion action is primary for purchases — the Google & YouTube app, a GTM tag or a GA4 import — and is enhanced conversions on?
Do you sell into the EU/UK or Quebec, and how is consent handled for those visitors?
Are browse- and cart-abandonment flows live in Klaviyo, and are Viewed Product / Added to Cart metrics recording?
